The `Generating` category of the DeFiChain JSON-RPC interface exposes 1 command. The text below is the help output of the node itself, so it matches the binary that generated this page.

For the complete interface, see the [RPC and CLI reference](../index.md).

## generatetoaddress

```text
generatetoaddress nblocks "address" ( maxtries )

Mine blocks immediately to a specified address (before the RPC call returns)

Arguments:
1. nblocks     (numeric, required) How many blocks are generated immediately.
2. address     (string, required) The address to send the newly generated DFI to.
3. maxtries    (numeric, optional, default=-1) How many iterations to try.

Result:
[ blockhashes ]     (array) hashes of blocks generated

Examples:

Generate 11 blocks to myaddress
> defi-cli generatetoaddress 11 "myaddress"
If you are running the DeFi Blockchain wallet, you can get a new address to send the newly generated DFI to with:
```
